context: Post-PR50 mobile physical discovery and benchmark-first audit; documentation/authority only

facts.claim: Android native VPN is not operational
facts.detail: providerCoreReady() returns false; no Builder.establish() or forwarding core; MainActivity explicitly displays NOT LINKED

facts.claim: iOS packet tunnel is deliberately inoperative
facts.detail: startTunnel returns coreNotLinked; no packetFlow forwarding or setTunnelNetworkSettings

facts.claim: A real authorized Android 13 device is physically attached by USB for read-only ADB diagnosis
facts.provenance: ADB USB device and getprop commands on owner Linux host
facts.detail: FreeNet Hub package absent, unrelated VPN test application present; no APK installed and no phone VPN settings modified; device identifiers omitted

facts.claim: Android/iOS CI success tests fail-closed prototype behavior, not actual mobile VPN
FreeNet Hub currently has no project-wide software license declaration
facts.provenance: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and root repository license absence

methodBenchmark.finding: Actual Android VPN must use VpnService.prepare, protect upstream sockets, configure TUN and establish with a packet-forwarding implementation.
Apple packet tunnel requires a functioning extension with virtual interface configuration and packetFlow forwarding plus entitlement.
SFA has a working unprivileged TUN integration with Android VpnService.
SFI uses NetworkExtension for platform TUN; feature availability differs by OS.
Existing maintained client is GPL-3.0; copying/integrating requires compatible license decision.
Mobile platforms permit only one active VPN, so a test must not preempt another user application.

decision.choice: Evaluate a pinned, licensed mobile sing-box/libbox reuse rather than writing a raw TUN packet stack or presenting a nonfunctional wrapper as VPN.
decision.why: Established protocol/runtime test surface lowers risk and custom networking maintenance; nevertheless license, ABI, upstream pin/hash and native lifecycle compatibility must be verified first.
rejected: Claiming Android emulator build proves Internet tunneling
Activating empty TUN and blackholing traffic
Replacing another mobile VPN during physical testing
Importing GPL source without deciding repository license and distribution obligations
decision.extraControls: Limit V&V to provenance-pinned core, fail-closed start/stop, no leaks or loops, single install/update, real device upstream exit, DNS, reconnect, rollback, and iOS entitlement validation; do not add redundant gates.

openGates.next: Pinned core integration plus isolated build and device tests; preserve other VPN app
PacketFlow core plus Apple provisioning and physical Apple device
Owner selects project license and approves obligations before GPL-derived core reuse
WARP native Terms, authenticated sudo, proven rollback-safe DNS/Tailscale/L2TP cohabitation
Elevated UAC and recovery-safe system route and gateway trial

verifyVsValidate: Only code inspection and read-only physical ADB detection was performed in this milestone. No phone install/VPN authorization, TUN, native iOS, DNS-leak, or full-device VPN validation is claimed.
nextAction: Regenerate PUBLIC_MANIFEST, verify all source/release/security checks and push exact new SHA; merge only when Android emulator and 10/10 hosted matrix PASS.

confirmedRisk.claim: Debug Android UI permits VpnService.prepare despite missing forwarding core; approval may revoke a different VPN app
confirmedRisk.impact: Other active VPN may lose authorization although FreeNetHub cannot connect

mutation.objective: Prevent unlinked FreeNet Hub Android from requesting VPN ownership
mutation.change: Android UI has no VpnService.prepare call and exposes disabled nonfunctional control; CI checks source and UI absence of consent, no VPN service and unchanged interfaces without brittle exact node enabled/text assertion.
mutation.manifestResult: Rebuild preserves accepted crossplatform version 4.3.7-crossplatform-r51-linux-r20 and updates RELEASE.json crossPlatformManifestSha256 only; published installers unchanged

failurePrevention.rootCause: Mobile UI originally offered consent to prove VpnService lifecycle even though no forwarding implementation was available
failurePrevention.prevention: No VPN authorization prompts until a tested functioning core is linked
failurePrevention.guard: No permission call in MainActivity source; emulator UI no active permission option; service absent and interfaces unchanged.
failurePrevention.regression: Hosted Android emulator and full CI exact SHA required; no blind rerun
failurePrevention.manifestRootCause: Existing rebuild_crossplatform_manifest.py hardcoded superseded r18 version, rolling back r20 metadata during any rebuild
failurePrevention.manifestGuard: Rebuild derives version from existing authoritative manifest, fails if schema/version missing, then tests verify crossplatform+RELEASE/public manifest hashes
